_provenance.note: Hand-authored for issue #533 — no live GitLab mirror is reachable from this environment (record-fixtures.mjs's standing constraint), so the shape comes from the documented GitLab REST API v4 issues response (https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html), which carries BOTH `assignees` (array of user objects) and the legacy singular `assignee`. Mirrors github-issueList-assignees.json entry for entry so the parameterized contract suite asserts ONE set of outcomes over both providers: 901 populated, 902 read-and-genuinely-empty, 903 legacy-singular-only (the shape a GitLab CE instance predating multiple assignees returns), 904 no assignee field at all — which must normalize to null, never []. GitLab's user objects key the name as `username`, GitHub's as `login`; that is the only provider-specific input to `normalizeAssignees`.
